title: Body buzzing for no clear reason?
caption: Feeling jittery today? The day has a buzzy edge, so focus may come in short bursts and then drift—keep tasks small and add a quick stretch or a short step outside between them. Take a few 1–2 minute slow breathing resets and leave room to recoup.
snapshot: Geomagnetic activity sits in the unsettled range today. Solar wind looks typical overall. The magnetic field has leaned south at times. No recent flares or CMEs have been observed.
affects: Some may notice jittery energy or a wired-and-tired edge. Focus can come in shorter stretches with brief scatter or restlessness. Head pressure or headache sensitivity may sit a bit closer to the surface for those prone.
playbook:
- Use 1–2 minute slow breathing resets a few times today
- Take a short outdoor step or stretch between tasks
- Hydrate and keep caffeine steady rather than spiking
- Keep evening lights and screens softer to ease the wind-down
